description: This source file defines the QueryOrigin case class used for tracking query provenance in Spark SQL pipelines, including methods for merging origins and handling exceptions with provenance information.

classes.name: QueryOrigin
classes.description: A case class for recording provenance information of SQL queries, with methods to merge origins and attach origin info to exceptions.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges this QueryOrigin with another, preferring non-None values from the other.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges this QueryOrigin with an Origin object from Catalyst, extracting sqlText, line, and startPosition.

methods.name: addOrigin
methods.description: Adds a QueryOrigin to a Throwable as a suppressed exception if none is already present.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Retrieves the QueryOrigin stored as a suppressed exception in a Throwable, if any.
